findings.title: Volume is mounted as a directory where the app reads a file
findings.cause: container web exits because it reads /etc/app/config.yaml as a file, and /etc/app/config.yaml is where volume config (ConfigMap app-config) is mounted whole, without subPath, so the path is a directory holding the volume's files (config.yaml); its log says: "error: read /etc/app/config.yaml: is a directory"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
container web mounts volume config (ConfigMap app-config) at /etc/app/config.yaml

findings.fix: Mount the volume at /etc/app, so that /etc/app/config.yaml is the file of key config.yaml in it (other files of the image in /etc/app are then hidden), or mount only that key at /etc/app/config.yaml with subPath: config.yaml (a subPath mount does not follow later changes to the ConfigMap).
